construction: Each fixed case creates one private temporary simulator Store and one learner. Eight historical cases record the fixed source text through record_education_event, seed the exact same text through add_memory with real source links and current_activity scope, finish the source session, and explicitly continue that finished session through production continuation_replay/bump/continue_finished_session. The new question is a current source and shown user turn, with latest_input as the only checkpointed fast field. Two unreported-measurement cases have only their current source. All cases call unchanged production build_context using ordinary lexical recall; there are no manual context/history/evidence injections or semantic-query overrides.
seed_scope: Verbatim source-bound memory seeds make the evaluation about downstream retrieval/context and teaching fidelity, not the quality of an LLM consolidation. Source data, current questions and review labels are separate. No age inference, module inventory or measured completion is seeded into current fast state.
coverage: For every required historical source, preparation checks that the actual recalled memory has its real ID, exact original text and source ID and that production evidence resolves it as selected_ancestor at depth 1. The current source must remain exact at user_input with current relation. Any missing source or text is recorded as prepared_insufficient; the original positive_fidelity label remains unchanged. Model invocation skips insufficient cases and writes immutable NOT_RUN markers, rather than repairing prompts, relabeling or claiming success. These cases remain in the declared ten-case denominator.
prepare: Default provider-free preparation freezes the exact binary, own/shared probe source, fixture, method, teaching policy/schema and relevant actual production source bytes including current kimi_acp_stream.rs. It saves all unmodified requests, actual Store sources/memories/sessions, coverage and review criteria before any model calls. No source patch is silently applied by preparation.
execution: Explicit --real-synthetic invokes shared run_model_cases using production KimiProvider::generate_segments, bounded channel, decoder and DeliveryLedger. Each eligible case receives an exclusive attempt marker once. A failed protocol/cleanup attempt is preserved and stops that batch; later cases remain NOT_RUN unless the operator explicitly selects a different previously unattempted case within the same fixed set. Neither failed nor insufficient cases can be overwritten or retried in this directory. No raw provider stream/thought bodies, displayed/spoken receipts, TTS, devices or candidate application.
cleanup: Shared runner always attempts provider close after invocation, preserves close/running status and request process/directory/stderr cleanup metrics. Local pipe writes do not establish remote acceptance. Model alias/sampling are not independently frozen.
review: Method-aware independent review reads every segment, exact final body and every task/memory candidate against actual visible source text. Preserve original errors, differences, negation, numerical values/units and assistance level; separate present explanation from historical learner work and accepted future plans from execution. Unreported data does not establish an event never/not-yet happened; explicit negative reports still retain their negative meaning. A correct main answer with an unsupported extra clause fails the full case. Record legal citations, protocol/cleanup, source coverage and semantic fidelity separately. English final concatenation must also be reviewed for readable sentence spacing, separately from factual failure. No keyword-based semantic pass and no automatic semantic_quality_pass.
limits: Ten seen-method synthetic targeted cases are not a blind evaluation, broad bilingual/age classroom certification, memory-consolidation validation, model failure-rate estimate or strict causal A/B. Historical and checkpoint21 failures remain unchanged. No actual sound, browser or physical device acceptance is claimed. Diagnostic scope must stay tied to actual source/binary hashes.
